creator: alanonai
title: Engineering for Vibe Coders: Stripe is easy to wire in, but you must design subscription cancellation, webhook idempotency and Stripe-outage behaviour yourself instead of letting the AI guess

tools.name: 'Engineering for Vibe Coders' article series
tools.detail: creator's article on using Stripe safely; link in comments

claims: Stripe is usually easy for AI to integrate, but the app is not 'off the hook' on payment logic
Think up front: how subscriptions work, what happens when someone cancels months later
If Stripe sends the same payment event twice, can your app handle it? (idempotency)
If the backend cannot reach Stripe and Stripe holds the subscription truth, decide whether to allow some services or block the user
how_to_steps: Before prompting the AI for Stripe, write down subscription lifecycle rules (create, renew, cancel, lapse)
Design webhook handling to be idempotent (dedupe by event id)
Decide degraded-mode behaviour when Stripe is unreachable; consider caching subscription state locally
Read his Stripe article (link in comments)
on_screen_only: Title card: 'Engineering for AI Vibe Coders -- Stripe'
Lower-third captions: 'CAN YOUR APP HANDLE THAT?', 'BACKEND FAILS', 'ESPECIALLY IF STRIPE HOLDS THE INFORMATION ABOUT WHO HAS A SUBSCRIPTION'
cta: link to article in comments; comment if helpful

relevance.why: Haji ships paid apps; webhook idempotency, cancellation handling and Stripe-down behaviour are exactly the failure modes vibe-coded billing gets wrong

implement_score.why: Turn the three questions into a checklist/skill for any app with Stripe: idempotent webhook handler keyed on event.id, local subscription-status cache with grace period, explicit cancel/lapse states. A few hours per app

verify: Find the actual article URL (comments) and check it covers Stripe webhook signature verification too
Confirm Stripe's own guidance on idempotency keys and event retries

gap.what: New warning: Stripe billing robustness (idempotent webhooks, cancellation lifecycle, Stripe-outage fallback). Liked set has his Supabase and Vercel lock-in videos and login-security gaps, but nothing on payments logic
